events.summary: After the Battle of Bryce, Hazezon Tamar sent warnings and a plea for aid in the form of soldiers from the Craggy Coast city-states, and the ship stopped at the Red Agates.
events.quote: In 3334 AR , after the Battle of Bryce , Hazezon Tamar sent words of warning and a plea for aid in the form of soldiers from several of the city-states on the Craggy Coast .

relations.note: The islands are in the Sea of Serenity in southwestern Jamuraa.
relations.quote: The Red Agates is a group of islands somewhere in the Sea of Serenity in southwestern Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .
